card.name: Wording about how injectables are supplied
card.fires_on: Words in dosage and administration sections that describe how an injectable product is supplied or packaged, such as concentration, ready, syringe, container, available.

modes.label: Supply and packaging words
modes.description: Syringe, container, pre-connected or available in descriptions of how a product is supplied.

modes.label: Ready-to-use wording
modes.description: Words saying a product is ready for infusion or is a fixed dose.
modes.example: Argatroban Injection 50 mg/50 mL (1 mg/mL) is<< ready>> for intravenous infusion.

modes.label: Concentration and storage phrasing
modes.description: Words in concentration statements or hold-time limits.
modes.example: is supplied ready for intravenous administration at a<< concentration>> of 0.05 mg/mL

card.plain: It marks wording that describes how an injectable is packaged and ready to give.
